leads.title: Human Rights Campaign - 2024 Annual State Report
leads.documents: Classifies Tennessee as one of the lowest-ranking states in the country for LGBTQ rights
leads.detail: Cited as 'Human Rights Campaign's annual state report in 2024' - no URL visible in text

leads.title: Campbell v. Sundquist, Tennessee Court of Appeals (1996)
leads.documents: Unanimous ruling that Tennessee's sodomy statute was unconstitutional; law subsequently repealed by legislature same year
leads.detail: Case name 'Campbell v. Sundquist' 1996 cited in Sodomy law section - no URL visible

leads.title: Tenn. Code Ann. § 68-3-203(d)
leads.documents: 1977 state law prohibiting altering sex on birth certificate: 'The sex of an individual shall not be changed on the original certificate of birth as a result of sex change surgery'
leads.detail: Statute citation 'Tenn. Code Ann. § 68-3-203(d)' quoted verbatim - no URL visible

leads.title: Tennessee Senate Bill 1 (SB1), signed March 1, 2023
leads.documents: Ban on providing gender-affirming healthcare to any trans person under 18, in-state and via telehealth; cut-off July 1, 2023 for new care and March 31, 2024 for existing care; $25,000 AG enforcement provision
leads.detail: Cited as 'Tennessee Senate Bill 1 (SB1)' signed alongside Tennessee Adult Entertainment Act - no URL visible

leads.title: United States v. Skrmetti, U.S. Supreme Court (June 18, 2025)
leads.documents: 6-3 ruling upholding Tennessee ban on puberty blockers and hormone therapy for transgender teenagers as not violating Fourteenth Amendment equal protection; majority by Chief Justice Roberts, dissent by Justice Sotomayor
leads.detail: Cited as 'United States v. Skrmetti' agreed for review June 24, 2024, decided June 18, 2025 - no URL visible

leads.title: Bostock v. Clayton County / R.G. & G.R. Harris Funeral Homes Inc. v. EEOC (2020)
leads.documents: Supreme Court finding that firing individuals merely for being LGBTQ+ violates Title VII; provides federal employment protections available in Tennessee since 2020; Sixth Circuit March 7, 2018 precursor ruling
leads.detail: Cited as docket 17-1618, argued Oct 7, 2019, decided June 14, 2020 - no URL visible

leads.title: Tennessee Bureau of Investigation - Hate Crime Statistics Report 2019-2021
leads.documents: Records 0 incidents against transgender persons in 2019, 1 in 2020, and 2 in 2021; article notes possible underreporting vs DOJ records
leads.detail: Cited as 'Tennessee Bureau of Investigation's hate crime statistics report from 2019 through 2021' - no URL visible

leads.title: Tennessee Attorney General Formal Opinion - Herbert H. Slatery (February 2019)
leads.documents: States hate crime law implicitly covers gender identity because gender/sex is covered; crime against person because transgender is committed because of gender under § 40-35-114(17)
leads.detail: Opinion in response to Rep. Mike Stewart query on § 40-35-114(17) after Sen. Sara Kyle 2018 bill - no URL visible

leads.title: U.S. District Judge Waverly D. Crenshaw - Order October 20, 2023 (City of Murfreesboro)
leads.documents: Orders city 'shall not' enforce any code using term 'homosexuality' in definition of 'sexual conduct'; led to removal of homosexuality from local ordinance and $500,000 settlement Feb 7, 2024
leads.detail: Cited as ordinance 23-O-22 case brought by ACLU of Tennessee / Tennessee Equality Project - no URL visible

leads.title: Tennessee Adult Entertainment Act (2023) - Judge Thomas Parker ruling June 2023
leads.documents: Anti-drag law redefining 'adult cabaret performance' to ban male/female impersonators where minors might see; halted pre-enactment March 2023 and declared unconstitutional as vague and overbroad June 2023
leads.detail: Cited as Western District of Tennessee case, AG Jonathan Skrmetti Notice of Appeal June 2023, oral arguments Feb 1, 2024 - no URL visible
